zh.title: AI 复核员先看到答案，会被带偏吗？
zh.summary: 同一份报告先看还是后看？真实模型对照未见差异。CodeFlowMu 续验显示，能读回缺件记录时，接班 QA 每张工单只补查一份原件。

en.title: Does an AI reviewer get anchored by seeing the answer first?
en.summary: In a live-model comparison, report order made no observed difference. In the CodeFlowMu handoff, access to the missing-evidence record let each incoming reviewer reopen just one original.
